dependency.claim: reference fenced runtime only; frozen candidate kernel v1 unchanged

substrate.linearization: single serializable transaction with row locks
substrate.destination_effect: insert exact effect row and advance exact target state

native_boundary_checks: exact pre-effect target revision and digest
exact authority epoch and generation captured in custody

falsification_cases.name: stale owner after takeover
falsification_cases.expected: old owner/generation denied at PostgreSQL destination; new owner closes exactly one effect

falsification_cases.name: state drift after successful runtime revalidation
falsification_cases.expected: destination transaction denies effect and runtime remains UNKNOWN

falsification_cases.name: authority revoked after successful runtime revalidation
falsification_cases.expected: destination transaction denies effect and runtime remains UNKNOWN

falsification_cases.name: exact valid fencing token replay
falsification_cases.expected: second destination mutation denied; effect cardinality remains one

limits: This proves one PostgreSQL destination profile, not universal native fencing.
It does not manufacture distributed consensus outside PostgreSQL.
It does not change the frozen governed-action v1 primitive contract.
Other destinations must supply equivalent complete mediation and atomic checks in their own substrate.
